ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white/gray) pixels, approximately 0.15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black pigmentation across approximately 85% of the surface area. A central contiguous region of light-gray mottling is present surrounding the median notch. High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree pixel angle relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary. A notable deep indentation is visible on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical upward sweep. The trailing edge geometry displays mid-lobe convexity transitioning to a steep upward curve at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters are present on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light gray/white) are visible against the dark surface of the mid-fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch/tissue deficit located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible calcified barnacle attachments present along the distal tips and scattered along the trailing edge serrations.
